creator: Alexander Terp
description: Seen in simulation only, 2026-11-09 while investigating a_2pOzktc35. A PermissionRequest hook's blocked report that the screen rules never read stays in force when the screen redraws less often than every 1.5 s, because reporting.rs's 3-seconds-of-output rule never fires, so a long foreground command could read blocked for its whole run. Real Claude Code 2.1.319 redrew about 5 times a second, so no real pane has been seen doing this; a loaded machine is the likely case. A fix that let a visible spinner retire the report after 2 s was written and withdrawn: a background sub-agent keeps the busy title animating (osc_title_working), so a real unrecognized dialog's report would be dropped, and visible_working_since is not cleared when a menu covers the screen. A fix needs a foreground-spinner vs busy-title distinction and state cleared on covered screens.
title: A blocked report nobody read may hold over a sparsely redrawn spinner screen
